channel.title: Shelby County Newspapers - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Shelby County Newspapers (shelbycountyreporter.com)

item.title: Montevallo Main Street’s Monte Gras Ball draws 200 revelers in second year
item.description: Montevallo Main Street brought the spirit of Mardi Gras back to Liberty Hall at American Village on Saturday, Feb. 7, hosting its second annual Monte Gras Ball with record attendance, elaborate themed “Krewes” and a packed dance floor.

item.title: University of Montevallo postpones TPUSA event, citing safety concerns
item.description: The University of Montevallo has indefinitely postponed a Turning Point USA “Pick Up the Mic” event featuring 1819 News founder and CEO Bryan Dawson, citing safety and security concerns.

item.title: Pelham dismisses SSUT lawsuit to allow legislative review
item.description: The city of Pelham has voluntarily dismissed its legal challenge against the State of Alabama over the administration of the Simplified Sellers Use Tax, opting instead to give state lawmakers an opportunity to address concerns raised by municipalities across Alabama.

item.title: Pelham avenges losses to Spain Park, rolls to area title with 42-point win
item.description: Pelham beat Spain Park for the first time in their three meetings in 42-point fashion, winning the area championship by topping the lone team that it lost to this season.

item.title: Calera Eagles blast Benjamin Russell, secure Class 6A, Area 5 crown
item.description: The Calera Eagles hosted Benjamin Russell for the Class 6A, Area 5 championship game on Wednesday, Feb. 11. They won in blowout fashion to secure the area title and advance to sub-regionals.

item.title: Identity revealed of shooter who injured Hoover police officer in Southlake
item.description: The name of the shooter in an incident in the Southlake neighborhood in Hoover has been released.

item.title: Alabaster declares Feb. 15 as School Resource Officer Appreciation Day
item.description: On Monday, Feb. 9, Mayor Scott Brakefield delivered the proclamation to the Alabaster City Council

item.title: Pelham Cheer caps breakthrough season with semifinal finish at nationals
item.description: After breaking through with a regional title and a long-awaited bid to nationals, Pelham High School’s cheer team didn’t just make the trip to Orlando — it made a statement.

item.title: University of Montevallo trustees to vote on cutting several programs, 4 sports teams
item.description: University of Montevallo interim president Dr. Terry Roberson informed students of his recommendation to eliminate 16 minors and concentrations as well as the swimming and tennis programs.

item.title: Matthew Bevelle’s putback puts Thompson in Sweet 16 with 2OT win over Hillcrest-Tuscaloosa
item.description: Matthew Bevelle’s game-winning putback lifted Thompson into the Sweet 16 thanks to a double-overtime victory over Hillcrest-Tuscaloosa in the area semifinals.
